description:
NOVA-X Mission Control 🚀

Design your own space mission to the Moon or Mars! Choose your spacecraft, manage resources, plan trajectories, and make decisions that determine mission success. Our AI-powered Mission Advisor helps you optimize designs, identify risks, and make smarter choices, while our simulation engine puts every decision to the test.

No magic buttons, no guaranteed success — just smart engineering and space adventure!

6 Minds. One Mission. Zero Room for Bad Calculations. 🌌
